name: Wealthfront
description: Wealthfront is a consumer wealth-management platform offering automated investing, direct indexing, bond portfolios, cash accounts, borrowing, and financial planning. Customers use its own web and mobile applications to manage portfolios and long-term financial goals.
agentUseSummary: Wealthfront does not publish a supported third-party customer-account API, so Relay does not capture login credentials, automate private clients, or expose agent actions.
